title: The Colours of Light
summary: White light is a mixture of seven colours. Prisms, rainbows, Newton’s disc and coloured filters.

ib.note: Wavelength and the electromagnetic spectrum follow in MYP 4–5

cbse.chapter: The Human Eye and the Colourful World (dispersion)

objectives: I can describe how a prism splits white light into a spectrum (dispersion).
I can explain how a rainbow forms and why the colours appear in the order VIBGYOR.
I can explain what Newton’s disc and coloured filters show about white light.
misconceptions: The prism adds the colours to the light.
White is not a colour made of light.
A red filter turns light red by adding red.
